ValidationRule.description: IM-368: Making BRM Field field required if field type is not None
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( BRM_Field_Type__c , 'Field'),ISPICKVAL( BRM_Field_Type__c , 'JSON'),ISPICKVAL( BRM_Field_Type__c , 'Object')), ISBLANK( BRM_Field__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: BRM Field value is required if BRM Field Type is not None
